name: russellvault2
description: The Russell Vault operations app — replaces the reconciliation spreadsheets with a live inventory, cost-basis, listing, and sales workflow.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.ci:install: npm ci && npm ci --prefix client && npm ci --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.build:ci: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client && node --test scripts/db/guard.test.mjs scripts/ci/client-audit-gate.test.mjs
